description: Warm evening: the occupant opens the bedroom window and the whole-house fan ventilates the 78 F house. She closes the window and the fan stops. The AC must come back within the release quiet time instead of staying Off for hours.

events.note: The hallway thermostat's own sensor: satisfied, so it will not start by itself.
Seed the door/window sensor as closed.
Day classification (cold: heat all night / hot: cool all night).
Bedtime: the sleep band is written and the sleep window (remote sensor in use) begins.
The occupant opens the window; outdoor air is cooler: natural ventilation.
The hallway reading moves: the comfort check runs against the bedroom reading (78 F, above the sleep ceiling).

assertions.reason: After the window closes and the fan reads off, the pre-fan cool mode is given back (not left Off behind a stranded whole-house-fan suppression).

notes: Tier A coordinator mode (use_coordinator=true): the fan's physical state is read through the coordinator's fan-state feedback, which is what makes the stale 'fan still on' reading at the nat-vent exit reproduce; the engine-only run has no physical reading and never meets the deferral.
Occupant impact: the house sat at 78 F against a 72 F ceiling for 2+ hours after the fan stopped; the thermostat stayed Off because the whole-house fan still 'owned' it (v0.8.41-0.8.45).

(a) Effectiveness: with the Issue #1271 arming deleted from _deactivate_fan the cool restore never happens (the strict-xfail reproduction in tests/test_whf_nat_vent_close_restore_1271.py failed the same way), so last_hvac_mode stays off and this assertion fails.

(b) Docs vs production: docs/fan-lifecycle-spec.md (restore after a deferred stop) and docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md WHF safety table: a fan stop whose restore was deferred hands it to the one gated release.
(c) Occupant outcome if a regression is missed: a warm house with no cooling for hours after closing the window.

verdict.summary: Closing the window ends ventilation and the AC comes back once the fan has stayed off.
verdict.expected_behavior: The pre-fan mode is restored after the quiet window; the thermostat is never left Off behind a fan that has stopped.

name: issue_1271_whf_window_close_restores_cool
source: Issue #1271: cool WHF nat-vent ended by a window close; the AC must come back once the fan reads off (regression of #1215)
